## Question 1
```{r question_1}
# read in 
penguins = readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmegahed/isa401/main/data/penguin_captures.csv")

dplyr::glimpse(penguins)

penguins|> dplyr::count(species, sort = TRUE)

penguins |>
  dplyr::group_by(penguins$species) |>

```

## Question 6 
```{r question_6}
# how many traffic crashes happened in Cincinnati in July 2026?

# Claude code from exam 
library(httr2)

resp <- request("https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json") |>
  req_url_query(
    `$select` = "count(*) AS n",
    `$where` = "crashdate >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00' AND crashdate < '2026-08-01T00:00:00'"
  ) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

as.integer(resp[[1]]$n)

# Code checking 

resp <- httr2::request("https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json") |>
  httr2::req_url_query(
    `$where` = "crashdate between '2026-07-01T00:00:00' and '2026-07-31T23:59:59'",
    `$limit` = 50000
  ) |>
  httr2::req_perform()

crash_df <- resp |> httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

nrow(crash_df)                          # people/vehicles (rows): 2400
dplyr::n_distinct(crash_df$instanceid)  # crashes: 1166

crash_df |> dplyr::count(instanceid, sort = TRUE) |> head()
dplyr::n_distinct(crash_df$localreportno)
```

## Question 7
```{r question_7}
library(rvest)
library(purrr)

base_url <- "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/exam/registry?start="
starts   <- seq(from = 1, to = 321, by = 40)

get_classes <- function(s) {
  Sys.sleep(1)
  rvest::read_html(paste0(base_url, s)) |>
    rvest::html_elements(".ship-class") |>
    rvest::html_text2()
}

classes <- purrr::map(starts, get_classes) |> unlist()

length(classes)               # expect 360
table(classes)
sum(classes == "Dreadnought")
```

## Question 10 
```{r question_10}
library(dplyr)

jobs <- data.frame(
  posting = 1:2400,
  location_state = rep(state.abb[1:12], times = 200)
)

nrow(jobs)                      # 2400
dplyr::n_distinct(jobs$location_state)   # 12

result <- jobs |>
  dplyr::group_by(location_state) |>
  dplyr::summarise(postings = dplyr::n())

nrow(result)                    # should print 12
result
```

## Question 11
```{r question_11}
library(ellmer)

# 1. Create a chat object
chat <- ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna"
)

# 2. Define the Airbnb listing description
description <- "This one of a kind, turn of the century, fully restored mansion is just waiting for you to come and enjoy the vast amenities this house offers! This historic Victorian Mansion was built in the last 1800's and has been fully restored and updated with one thing in mind--luxury! We boast a slate pool table, 10 person hot tub, a custom made fire table, a built in giant projector screen for streaming, arcade games, and much much more! We comfortably sleep 19 guests with 9 dedicated bedrooms."

# 3. Define the structured output schema
schema <- ellmer::type_object(
  property_type = ellmer::type_string(),
  max_guests = ellmer::type_integer(),
  num_bedrooms = ellmer::type_integer(),
  key_amenities = ellmer::type_string(
    "List key amenities separated by |"
  )
)

# 4. Extract structured information
result <- chat$chat_structured(
  description,
  type = schema
)

# 5. Display results
print(result)
```
